RecordingStartLevel.description:
The lowest level of an App's governed Space whose members may start and stop
recordings. `member` means everyone in the Space. Stored as its wire string.

oneOf.description: Nobody through the App's levels (the default; roles and overwrites still apply).
Sew's own model: roles, overwrites and membership are edited in Sew (the default).
The governing App decides membership, private channels and levels (K2's sync).

The server-governed Space (named `K5 Space`), one per K2 install, owned by `k2:server`:
K2's daemon decides its structure over mgmt; no App session ever reaches it.

SpaceJoinPolicy.description: Who may join a space by themself.

oneOf.description: Any active non-guest member may join.
Members join only when someone adds them (the default).

description:
Answer of `GET`/`POST /mgmt/v1/spaces/{space_id}/settings`: the values after the
call.

governance.description: Who governs the Space's structure. Old payloads read as `sew`.

recording_required.description:
Flag `app_recording`: the Space's own "record every call with two or more people";
absent when it inherits.

recording_start_level.description: Flag `app_recording`: the Space's own recording start level; absent when it inherits.
